brand.name: SAK AI Assistant
brand.creator: Suqiya
brand.theme: Light & Dark Mode (Dark Mode Toggle Required)
brand.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) blended with Sky Blue (Archetype 3 Influence)
brand.vibe: Intelligent, fluid, accessible, trustworthy, premium SaaS

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use texture (noise, grain) or strategic blurs over gloss.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000. Tint greys with blue (slate/slate-950) to match the Sky theme.
Hover text color must always be explicitly defined (e.g., hover:text-white).
Do NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Stick to Sky Blue.
BANNED FONTS: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Syne for Headings. Space Grotesk is forbidden.
Tight letter spacing on headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Never fill 100% of the bento grid perfectly in marketing. Leave 'breathing room' or use empty cells for offset alignment.
Optical Alignment: If a button has an icon on the left, add extra padding to visually center the text block.

styles.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]
styles.dashboard_card: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl
styles.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-sky-500/30 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(14,165,233,0.1)]

rules: Glassmorphism must have a 1px delicate inner stroke to separate it from the background.
Headers over scrolling content MUST use Crystal Glass.
Dashboards should use subtle roundness, max 12px (rounded-xl).

ai_chat_interface.message_bubbles: User: bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-900/20. AI: Transparent with border or subtle slate bg.

image_generation_studio.layout: Left/Right split or Godly-style filtered grid
features: Prompt input with advanced settings (ratio, style)

notes_bookmarks.layout: Masonry grid or clean list view

rules: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural/marketing layouts. Use Shadcn components for interactive logic (Forms, Select, Dialog).
Always include `data-testid` attributes on interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="chat-send-button"`).
Customize Shadcn components to match the brand (Sky blue focus rings, adjusted radii).

animations.page_transitions: framer-motion for smooth fade and slide-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1)

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react (already installed). Use clear, consistent stroke widths (usually 2px).

images.description: Dark blue abstract background with soft shapes. Use as the hero section background with a dark overlay (bg-slate-950/80) to ensure text readability.
AI Interface showcase for the landing page feature section.

rules: Images must be responsive and not exceed 80vh on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Start by setting up the Tailwind configuration with the custom colors (sky-50 to sky-950, and slate variables) and fonts (Outfit, Manrope).
2. Setup Dark Mode functionality using standard Tailwind `dark:` classes and a toggle context.
3. Build the Landing/Auth Page using the 'hero_background' image. Use glassmorphism for the header.
4. Implement the AI Chat Interface with a sidebar for history. Use proper markdown rendering libraries (e.g., react-markdown) and ensure the input area handles multi-line text gracefully.
5. Build the Image Generation Studio as a Godly-inspired grid or split-pane view with prompt inputs and parameter sliders.
6. Build the Translation Tool supporting 15+ languages using standard select dropdowns and side-by-side text areas.
7. Implement Notes & Bookmarks using a masonry or clean list layout.
8. Ensure every interactive element has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="dark-mode-toggle"`).
9. DO NOT ask the user for clarifications. Proceed with these creative decisions.
